effect Drafts
    save : (string, string) => Result<int, Error>
saveDraft () = match perform Drafts.save "draft.txt" "Ship it."
    Success _ => "Saved"
    Error message => "Retry: ${message}"

disk = handler Drafts
    save path text => writeFile path text
offline = handler Drafts
    save _ _ => Error(message = "offline")

print "${disk saveDraft} / ${offline saveDraft}"
